owner_exact_instruction: Đổi agy, claude sang codex. Executor và reviewer đều là codex. Reviewer có mô hình hoặc nỗ lực cao hơn và có thể chạy ở máy khác

reviewer.context: fresh independent read-only context/checkout; no source fork
reviewer.different_machine: allowed, optional; never replaces independent context or higher setting

assurance: same_provider_approved under explicit owner-scoped policy; never cross_approved
actual_serving_disclosure: record if measured; never infer actual effort/model from requested config
existing_canonical_init: expected rc4, no journal fabricated or guard bypassed
implementation_status: scoped candidate policy pending finite/manual development allowance
status: approved requirements, real candidate implementation pending
time_activation: pending explicit current approved time envelope pinned in lease
